title: Practice: thinking, effort and speed set correctly per model (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 each course model gets the request it accepts
cases.says: Each course model gets the request it accepts

cases.id: e1 thinking modes a model does not have are refused
cases.says: Thinking modes a model does not have are refused

cases.id: e2 the mode that skips thinking up front is sonnet only and needs high effort or below
cases.says: The mode that skips thinking up front is Sonnet only and needs high effort or below

cases.id: e3 effort needs a supporting model and a real level
cases.says: Effort needs a supporting model and a real level

cases.id: e4 newer models reject sampling parameters and haiku keeps them
cases.says: Newer models reject sampling parameters and Haiku keeps them

cases.id: e5 fast mode is opus only with its beta header and never in a batch
cases.says: Fast mode is Opus only, carries its beta header and is never sent in a batch

cases.id: e6 a manual budget is at least 1024 and below max tokens
cases.says: A manual budget is at least 1,024 and below max_tokens; max_tokens is at least 1

cases.id: e7 effort lives in output config and never inside thinking
cases.says: Effort lives in output_config, never inside thinking, and the options are left unchanged
